question: Can the unchanged bounded-hold controller complete a fresh matched pair and the declared branch diagnostics through a correctly bound final workflow auditor?
reason: R10T completed its 220-test gate, physical trajectory and original native replay, but the shared declaration validator required 1500 child-wall seconds while the frozen design and launcher declared 1740. The separate post-exposure full audit passes all finite predicates with only that host-limit substitution. R10T remains consumed infrastructure-invalid and its chain is closed.

limits.wall_basis: The physical horizon gains at most 240 commands. The child wall ceiling gains a bounded 240 seconds over R10S; this changes no solver timing, controller threshold or physical result criterion.

conditional_hold_rule: Preserve every conditional hold, readiness, dwell, ownership and fresh-memory rule in the bound predecessor design.
allowed_change: Carry the exact selected immutable candidate host deadline through the real shared declaration validator and final auditor. Implement the distinct successor identity and source/runtime bindings without changing native control behavior.
qualification_requirements: Complete the dependency manifest, actual production entrypoint integration, negative controls, clean pushed freeze and complete applicable safety gate before physics.

Exercise the real final-auditor declaration path using the actual launcher-generated successor fields; test the declared 1740 value plus stale 1500, crossed values, booleans, missing values and wrong-profile substitutions. Do not test only a sibling validator.

Exercise the complete final audit on retained exposed data under a separately labeled diagnostic and preserve its provenance. This is zero-world qualification evidence, not a replacement physical attempt or baseline.

Keep actual unbound launch, ownership, bounded stepping, native replay, report finalization and no-claim publication coverage. Preserve the original test populations or prospectively declare and justify any successor population change.

Keep the original R10T declaration, supervisor failure, audit failure, replay, source key and one-use reservation unchanged. No patched global constant in production and no promotion of the diagnostic into an R10T prerequisite.

development_coverage.coverage_adequacy: The R10T exposed trajectory already exercises the physical hold and all walking cycles, but its final workflow is invalid. The smallest complete fresh population for the remaining matched-role publication and auditor risk is one no-kick child and one kicked child. A separate preliminary kicked child would add no distinct named interface coverage. This pair must qualify from its own original successful supervisor and audit; the old trajectory supplies no baseline or acceptance credit.
development_coverage.if_pair_not_valid_positive: Close the R10U chain and retain the attempt. No later R10U physical diagnostic may launch.
development_coverage.additional_negative_rule: Retain every result once. Remaining predeclared branch diagnostics may complete for coverage; any invalid or negative prevents held-out declaration under this design.
development_coverage.held_out_precondition: All five fresh development cells must be valid finite positives under their original workflow, with the required hold/direct branches. Then declare a separate fresh held-out population, qualification, one-use authority, finite decision and release-gate adoption.
